architecture: V6-B (V6 hybrid minus transition block d_B,g) -- output of the predeclared rule applied mechanically (SELECTION_RESULTS.json)
classifier_primary: LogisticRegression(L2, max_iter=2000), C tuned in {0.1,1,10} by inner GroupKFold(3) on training programs; Platt calibration on inner OOF
classifier_secondary: HistGradientBoosting(random_state=0), max_depth{2,3} x max_iter{50,100}, same inner tuning
outer_cv: 5-fold program-grouped; final holdout models fit on all DEV (v8 train+val) with same recipe
orientation: forward, fixed a priori; never selected on held-out data
holdouts_touched: NONE. v8 test (H1), v10 (H2), X1, X2 not read by any audit script (grep-verified below). H1/H2 were already observed for V5 per the protocol, so they are non-pristine; they have not been run for V6.
